description: A compact overview of the open project: file, tempo, transport, undo state, the master and every track (id, name, level, pan, mute/solo/arm, effects, sends, items) and the markers. Start here: tools name tracks by the ids and names it shows. Times are in seconds.

format.description: `summary` (default): a few lines per track. `json`: the full snapshot, which can be large.

items.description: List every item (media clip) under its track, with its id, position and length.

name: get_project
title: Project overview

description:

Control API command `transport.play`.
name: transport_play
title: Transport play

description:
Stops and leaves the edit cursor where playback was.

Control API command `transport.pause`.
name: transport_pause
title: Transport pause

description:
Stops (ending a recording) and returns to the edit cursor.

Control API command `transport.stop`.
name: transport_stop
title: Transport stop

description:
Starts recording the armed tracks; `transport.stop` ends it.

Control API command `transport.record`.
name: transport_record
title: Transport record

description:
Moves the edit cursor, and the playhead while playing.

Control API command `transport.seek`.

position.description: Seconds from the start of the project.

name: transport_seek
title: Transport seek

description:
Turns repeat on or off and/or sets the range it repeats.

Control API command `transport.loop`.
name: transport_loop
title: Transport loop

description:
Turns the metronome (click) on or off and/or sets its level at its outputs (`volume` as
gain, REAPER's default 0.25, or `db`). Saved with the project, like REAPER's.

Control API command `transport.metronome`.

enabled.description: On or off; left out, it stays as it is.

name: transport_metronome
title: Transport metronome

description:
Where the metronome plays: device output `output` (from 0; a pair unless `mono`), or
with the master when `null`. Pointed at a drummer's in-ear output, the click reaches
only them. REAPER's metronome hardware output (`METRONOMEOUT`), saved with the project;
with `default` the preference for projects that name none (`metronome_defout`).

Control API command `transport.metronome_output`.

default.description: Set the default output, a preference, instead of the project's.

mono.description: Play to that one output instead of the pair starting there.

output.description:
First device output, from 0; `null` plays it with the master (or, for the project,
to the default output).

name: transport_metronome_output
title: Transport metronome output

description:
Count-in: whether playback and/or recording start after `measures` measures of
metronome at the tempo where they start. As in REAPER, there is no count-in while the
metronome is off (a setlist's count-in clicks regardless).

Control API command `transport.count_in`.

measure_start.description:
"Start count-in at start of measure": count in from the bar line before the start,
a preference rather than a project setting.

playback.description: Count in before playback (REAPER's "Count-in before playback").

name: transport_count_in
title: Transport count in

description:
Pre-roll (preferences, as in REAPER): playback and/or recording start `measures`
measures before the position asked for; a recording keeps only what comes after it.

Control API command `transport.preroll`.

measure_start.description: "Start pre-roll at start of measure" (on by default).

name: transport_preroll
title: Transport preroll

description:
The audio device and how it holds up: xruns, DSP load, latency, a lost device.

Control API command `transport.health`.
name: transport_health
title: Transport health

description:
Play state, playhead and edit cursor, loop and metronome.

Control API command `transport.state`.
name: transport_state
